author: Darya
text:
It's already been two months since our trip and still, scrolling back through my gallery, I can't believe this happened to me (!!)

All those views, the ever-changing coves, swimming in the open sea — wow 💔

I was so lucky to discover this kind of holiday with Sofa of all people, she is an incredible captain
